provenance: simulated in this run (8 seeds x 8 conditions x 1200 ticks)

claims.claim: In the unmanaged control, local reproduction persists at the end of the run while scale-2 reproduction collapses and the builder fraction is more than halved.
claims.detail: local birth retention 1.078 [1.072, 1.085] (need >= 0.80, lo > 0.50); propagule retention 0.113 [0.049, 0.194] (need <= 0.25, hi < 0.50); builder retention 0.161 [0.094, 0.247] (need <= 0.50, hi < 0.75).

claims.claim: Intervening on the cost link alone raises late-window scale-2 reproduction above the control by at least 0.351 propagules/tick (2 between-seed SD of the control), with a paired 95% interval above zero.

Intervening on the boundary link alone raises late-window scale-2 reproduction above the control by at least 0.351 propagules/tick (2 between-seed SD of the control), with a paired 95% interval above zero.

Intervening on the signal link alone raises late-window scale-2 reproduction above the control by at least 0.351 propagules/tick (2 between-seed SD of the control), with a paired 95% interval above zero.

Across all runs, late scale-2 reproduction is gated by the local builder fraction (Spearman rho >= 0.70) and not by the late local birth rate (|rho| < 0.50): the bottleneck separating local from hierarchical reproduction is the collective's builder supply.
The three interventions are super-additive: applying all three exceeds the sum of the three single-link gains over control by at least the between-seed floor, with a paired 95% interval above zero.
